$comment: Scripts of the memory strip, drawn by MemoryStrip.astro. A region's cells are a string, eight cells to a line: '.' free, 'o' other data, 's' the secret (shown as a byte of `key`), 'x' a stale copy of the secret (hatched), '0' zeroed, '?' not written yet. `count` is the number of places the key can be read. `scope` names the region the brace holds while the secret is in use. `refs` cite a leak card (L1 to L9) or a ledger row (R1 to R8). Captions take `code` and [links](/x/).

life-of-a-key.title: The life of a key
life-of-a-key.summary: The same 32-byte key, drawn as eight cells, held in an ordinary array and in a buffer from `Rent` with `isSensitive: true`, step by step.

tracks.label: A buffer from `Rent`
tracks.code: Rent(32, isSensitive: true, out Span<byte> key)

ordinary.caption: `new byte[32]` places an array between other objects on the heap. It starts as zeros.

sensitive.caption: `Rent` hands back a buffer on the pinned heap. What it holds is not known yet: write before you read.

ordinary.caption: The key is written into the array.

sensitive.caption: The key is written into the start of the buffer. The rest of the buffer is still unwritten.

ordinary.caption: The collector copies the array to a new address. The old cells keep the key until something is written over them.

sensitive.caption: Other objects move. The pinned buffer does not, so the key is still in one place.

ordinary.caption: `ToArray()`, or a `string` of the key, makes one more place that holds it.

sensitive.caption: The same copy here would be ordinary memory again: the library cannot reach it. This code makes none.

ordinary.caption: The method returns. Nothing clears the array, its old cells or the copy.

sensitive.caption: `Dispose` overwrites the whole buffer with zeros, the part after the key included, on every way out of the `using` block.

ordinary.caption: Until other data is written over them, a crash dump or a page file can hold all three.

sensitive.caption: The pool can rent the buffer to the next caller, who gets zeros, not your key.
